payload.summary: Remove remaining PR 3538 leftovers after 13 Nov 2026 (follow-up to #08216B)
payload.detail: After the 30-day dead-code candidate window (2026-11-13), delete or wire the remaining PR 3538 leftovers flagged in #08216B: /api/proxy route (remove or restrict to an explicit allowlist), scripts/recalculate-answer-support-labels.ts (replace regex chunk-tag stripping with shared parser or delete), src/app/mockups/development/* pages, and unwired safe-number editor / attendance roster / QR helper / note editor privacy review.
